paper.abstract_en: The notion of conicality, recently introduced in [2403.00916], captures the extent to which the joint future of a finite set in spacetime uniquely determines the generating subset via its light cone structure. In the same paper it was mentioned that conicality holds for Minkowski spacetime of dimension $1+N$ with $N\geq 2$ and it has been conjectured that this property holds more generally. In this work, we show that neither homotopy with Minkowski space nor global hyperbolicity alone are sufficient for the spacetime to satisfy conicality. We then establish that causally simple, future cohesive spacetimes of dimension $1+N$ with $N\geq 2$ are conical. This class of spacetimes includes, in particular, TIP spacetimes, which can be understood as the timelike past of an observer. This is in line with the origin of causal modeling since the past of an observer is the natural domain for the description of experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究因果结构中的锥性（conicality）性质，属于广义相对论基础与因果理论的核心议题。摘要明确给出反例（同伦于 Minkowski 或整体双曲性自身不足），并证明因果简单、未来粘合的时空（含 TIP 时空）满足锥性，理论深度与新颖性较高，结构清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 锥性（conicality）这一概念最近在 [2403.00916] 中被引入，它刻画的是时空中一个有限集合的共同未来在多大程度上通过其光锥结构唯一确定其生成子集。同一篇论文中提到，锥性对维度为 $1+N$ 且 $N\geq 2$ 的 Minkowski 时空成立，并猜想该性质在更一般的情形下也成立。在本工作中，我们证明：与 Minkowski 空间的同伦性，或整体双曲性，单独都不足以使时空满足锥性。随后我们建立：维度为 $1+N$ 且 $N\geq 2$ 的因果简单、未来粘合的时空是锥性的。这一类时空特别包括 TIP 时空，后者可以理解为某个观测者的时间性过去。这与因果建模的起源相一致，因为观测者的过去是描述实验的自然定义域。
